name: How does air sealing enhance the value of a whole-home remodel or addition?

mainEntity.name: How does air sealing enhance the value of a whole-home remodel or addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Integrating air sealing into a whole-home remodel or addition significantly enhances the project's long-term value by improving energy performance and indoor air quality. During substantial renovations, our integrated design-build process allows for effective access to areas that would be difficult to seal later, such as behind new walls or within upgraded HVAC systems. This proactive approach ensures that new construction elements contribute to a truly high-performing and comfortable living environment, aligning with our commitment to enhancing functionality, beauty, and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Air sealing enhances remodel value by improving energy performance and comfort, making it easier to integrate during extensive renovations for a high-performing home.
